# 00000002606

**English.** Definition: Ortholattices: lattices with a complementation operation. Conjecture: Morphisms of atomic ortholattices are generated by partial bijections, with the minimal number of generators the rank of the lattice; the image of a morphism is an ortho-sublattice, and the rigid classification is complete at rank at least three. (ortholattice morphism rigidity)

**中文。** 定义：正交格（ortholattice）：带补运算的格。猜想：原子正交格的态射由部分双射生成且生成元的极小数为格的秩；态射的像为正交子格且刚性分类在秩至少三时完备。（正交格态射刚性）
